Set the compilation default to 25 as well.

threads.body: [General] Unconditionally setting this launcher prevents tests from inheriting a project's newer toolchain. For example, #20186 sets `maxJavaVersionSupported` to 27 for Helidon latest-dependency builds, but this branch would still launch those tests on 25 and fail to load Helidon 27 class files. Only override the launcher for projects capped below 25; otherwise leave it unset so Gradle inherits the project toolchain.

threads.body: [Build] `maxJavaVersionSupported` is not defined by `OtelJavaExtension`, and it is not used to select the compiler toolchain. This preview-source suite still needs `javaToolchainVersion` pinned to `minJavaVersionSupported`; otherwise the new Java 25 default does not preserve the required compile/run version match.

threads.body: [Build] `maxJavaVersionSupported` is not defined by `OtelJavaExtension`, and the compiler toolchain selection only reads `javaToolchainVersion`. This therefore does not cap Grails compilation at Java 21 as intended; configure the existing toolchain property instead.
